editorial.description_en: The yellow-white light of an early spring afternoon, before the air clears.
editorial.description_ja: 春の靄のような、やわらかい黄みの白。

provenance.derivation: Editorial construction, not a measurement. Specified in OKLCh as L 0.880, C 0.026, h 96.0° and converted to canonical D65 XYZ by @irodora/color-spaces 0.1.0 (oklchToXyz), rounded to six decimal places. Re-derivable from this sentence alone.
provenance.editorialNotes: Name coined by Irodora: 春 (haru, spring) + 靄 (moya, haze). It is not asserted to be a traditional Japanese colour name, and the hyphenated romaji marks it as a constructed compound (ADR-0065). "Spring Haze" is an editorial decision about what communicates in English, not a literal translation of 春靄. Relations asserted from measured proximity under the current engine, not from a source: related is the three nearest in CIELAB — kawaki-suna at ΔE00 3.6, asa-nuno at ΔE00 3.9, shira-tsuchi at ΔE00 4.2. complementary is empty because at chroma 0.026 the hue is not a reliable enough statement to oppose. historicalVariants is empty: this entry makes no historical claim to vary from.
